_doc: Single-letter variant badges, shown beside a card name. Letters: S Showcase, H Hyperspace, P Prestige, N Serialized (numbered), W Weekly Play, O promo, C Costco Exclusive, F Foil. Every variant the catalog carries needs a row here (tests/printing-badges.test.js reads the captured catalog and fails on a missing one); an empty list means the variant adds no badge.
